def: something saved, i.e. (abstractly) deliverance; hence, aid, victory, prosperity
kjv: deliverance, health, help(-ing), salvation, save, saving (health), welfare.

words.word: and he is become my salvation
for me then thou shalt help

occurrences.text: I have waited for thy salvation, O Lord.

words: and he is become my salvation
